title: Can a row repeat?
statement:
After `s = df.sample(50)`, can the same row of `df` appear twice in `s`?

[_]{a}

choices: Yes, but only when the seed is fixed
Yes, sampling is always with replacement
No, `df.sample` draws without replacement unless you pass `replace=True`
Only if `df` has fewer than 50 rows
explanations: The seed makes results repeatable; it doesn't change replacement.
Then pandas raises an error instead, because it can't draw 50 different rows.

hints: What is the default value of `replace` in `df.sample`?
Without replacement means each row at most once.
solution: `df.sample(n)` uses `replace=False` by default, so each row appears at most once.
